name: Single Sign-On
description:
Single Sign-On adds an OIDC login button to Jellyfin Web, provisions normal
Jellyfin users and device sessions, and lets existing users explicitly link
their Jellyfin account to an external identity. Playback, libraries, and all
other Jellyfin authorization continue to use Jellyfin's native user policy.
overview: OpenID Connect login, automatic user provisioning, and account linking for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog:
0.1.0.6: Restore the SSO-only login view when the local-account form is cancelled, so the manual login and forgot-password controls do not reappear.
0.1.0.5: Make the local-account fallback a full login button, prefill the SSO-only break-glass allowlist with the current administrator, surface settings-save errors, and show SSO-only state on the status page.
0.1.0.4: Add OIDC RP-initiated logout with a configurable post-logout redirect, intercept Jellyfin Web sign-out for SSO sessions, and fix the provider enabled badge spacing.
0.1.0.3: Add SSO-only password policy, a provisioned-user flag, admin link creation, and a password-policy endpoint for trusted integrations; improve admin card spacing.
0.1.0.2: Follow the Jellyfin theme palette so the settings and login UI stay readable in light and dark themes, and cache-bust static assets so updates apply immediately.
0.1.0.1: Fix the plugin settings page wrapper for Jellyfin's plugin configuration route.
0.1.0.0: Initial OIDC implementation with Authentik-oriented configuration,
automatic login-page injection, auto-provisioning, explicit account linking,
pending approvals, role mapping, audit log, and Quick Connect helper.
